synonyms: partial epigenetic reprogramming gene therapy (OCT4, SOX2, KLF4)
identity.compoundFamily: partial epigenetic reprogramming gene therapy (AAV-delivered, doxycycline-inducible OSK)
activeMoieties: AAV vector encoding OCT4, SOX2 and KLF4 (OSK)

regulatory.regulatoryStatus: investigational (FDA IND cleared 2026-01-28 per sponsor; Phase 1 NCT07290244 recruiting; not FDA-approved; not available outside the trial)
offLabelNotes: Only available inside the Phase 1 trial NCT07290244; there is no approved, compounded or research-use product.
Life Biosciences reports it is the first partial epigenetic reprogramming therapy cleared for human trials.

mechanism.mechanismSummary: ER-100 is an investigational gene therapy from Life Biosciences: an engineered AAV vector, injected into the eye (intravitreal), carries genes for three Yamanaka transcription factors — OCT4, SOX2 and KLF4 (OSK, without c-MYC). Expression is switched on only while the patient takes oral doxycycline (56 days in the trial). The aim is partial epigenetic reprogramming: restoring youthful gene-expression patterns in retinal ganglion cells without changing cell identity or the patient's DNA sequence.

formulations.dosageForm: intravitreal injection (one eye) of an investigational AAV gene therapy, plus oral doxycycline (activator) for 56 days

storage.beforeReconstitution: unknown (investigational product handled by trial sites)

reconstitution.instructions: n/a — supplied to trial sites for intravitreal injection; preparation details unknown

indications.population: Adults with open-angle glaucoma enrolled in Phase 1 NCT07290244 (dose escalation, one eye).
indications.benefitSummary: Phase 1 safety study. Sponsor-reported interim data (3 participants, 2026-10-08): 2 of 3 had at least 28% of visual-field points improve by more than 4 dB. Open-label, no control arm, not peer reviewed.

indications.useCase: non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, NAION (investigational)
indications.population: Adults with NAION; cohort opens after OAG dose selection (3, expandable to 6).
indications.benefitSummary: No human data yet; NAION cohort not yet dosed per the registry design.

dose.scheduleText: No approved dose. Trial dose levels are listed under dose reports with their sources.

notes: Not available outside the trial; there is no approved or community dose.

compatibility.vialCompatibilitySummary: n/a — single intravitreal injection given by trial investigators; never mixed.

contraindications.item: Not an available product; only given inside the Phase 1 trial
contraindications.notes: Any product sold as ER-100 or 'OSK therapy' outside the trial is not Life Biosciences' investigational product.

warnings.item: Long-term safety of in-vivo reprogramming is unknown
warnings.notes: Yamanaka-factor expression carries a theoretical risk of dedifferentiation or tumor formation; ER-100 omits c-MYC and limits expression to the doxycycline window. Participants are followed up to 5 years.

warnings.item: Intravitreal injection and AAV vector risks
warnings.notes: Intraocular inflammation and immune response to the vector are known class risks of intravitreal AAV therapy; the trial tracks treatment-emergent adverse events and dose-limiting toxicities to Day 112.

common: unknown (3 participants reported; no dose-limiting toxicities, serious adverse events or adverse events of special interest through Day 56 per sponsor)
serious: none reported to date (n=3, sponsor interim)

monitoring.parameter: treatment-emergent adverse events and dose-limiting toxicities
monitoring.reason: Primary safety endpoints of the Phase 1 trial
monitoring.frequency: baseline to Day 56 and Day 112, then long-term follow-up up to 5 years

monitoring.reason: Primary safety laboratory endpoint (systemic doxycycline and vector exposure)
monitoring.frequency: during and after the doxycycline activation period

interactions.mechanism: Doxycycline is the activator: OSK is expressed only while it is taken
interactions.effect: Doxycycline is part of the regimen, not an interaction to avoid; its own side effects and interactions apply during the 56 days.

applicabilityNotes: n/a — investigational single-dose trial therapy; no supportive guidance applies.

claimSpecificEvidence.claim: ER-100 is an AAV-delivered, doxycycline-inducible OSK (OCT4, SOX2, KLF4) partial epigenetic reprogramming therapy given by intravitreal injection.
claimSpecificEvidence.gradeRationale: Registry intervention description and sponsor IND announcement; a factual description of the product.

claimSpecificEvidence.claim: Partial reprogramming with OSK restored youthful DNA-methylation patterns, axon regeneration and vision in mouse models of optic nerve injury, glaucoma and aging.
claimSpecificEvidence.gradeRationale: Peer-reviewed animal study (Lu et al., Nature 2020); mechanistic and preclinical only, no human evidence.

claimSpecificEvidence.claim: ER-100 was tolerated in the first 3 open-angle glaucoma participants through Day 56, with no dose-limiting toxicities, serious adverse events or adverse events of special interest.
claimSpecificEvidence.gradeRationale: Sponsor press release; n=3, open-label, interim, not peer reviewed.

claimSpecificEvidence.claim: ER-100 improves vision in glaucoma (2 of 3 participants had at least 28% of visual-field points improve by more than 4 dB).
claimSpecificEvidence.gradeRationale: Credible early clinical signal but n=3, no control, open-label, sponsor-reported, not peer reviewed; safety, not efficacy, is the primary endpoint.
No human NAION data yet; cohort follows OAG dose selection.

claimSpecificEvidence.claim: Partial epigenetic reprogramming like ER-100 reverses aging in the whole body.
claimSpecificEvidence.gradeRationale: ER-100 is a local eye therapy; no human evidence for systemic age reversal exists.

evidenceGaps: Efficacy is unknown: the trial's primary endpoints are safety and tolerability.
Results so far are sponsor-reported for 3 participants and not peer reviewed.
Dose level 2 (6 x 10^11 vg/eye) and NAION data are not yet reported.
Long-term (up to 5-year) safety of in-vivo reprogramming is unknown.
controversies: Longevity media present ER-100 as 'age reversal'; the human data so far are a 3-person eye safety readout.
